description:
Gift ideas from Man of Many's published gift guides.

    Args:
        recipient: who it is for, e.g. "dad", "boyfriend", "groomsmen", "coffee lover".
        budget_aud: optional maximum spend per gift in AUD.
        interests: optional interests, e.g. "golf, whisky".
        limit: number of ideas, 1 to 20 (default 10).
name: gift_finder
title: Gift finder
